summary: Build a production-ready multilingual hyperlocal services platform named “AREA WORKARS” (always uppercase) that connects (1) people searching for workers, (2) workers listing their services, and (3) businesses posting job requirements. Mobile-first, premium colorful corporate-but-rural-friendly UI. Search by area/pincode, browse categories with meaningful icons, view worker cards with direct Call/WhatsApp (no booking). Includes worker registration, public job request posting + job board, and an admin approval panel for workers and job posts. Multilingual: English default with an auto-selected regional language shown below based on selected state (Tamil/Kannada/Malayalam/Telugu/Hindi).
architectural_notes: Brand style: trustworthy, simple, rural+urban friendly; not corporate, not ecommerce; community-service feel
Color palette: dark green + white + light grey; emphasize accessibility and readability
Typography: clean, readable font that supports both Tamil and English well
Core UX: mobile-first; no booking system; no user login required; direct Call and WhatsApp contact
Information architecture: Home (search + category grid) -> Category listing pages with worker cards; separate Worker Registration page; simple Admin panel
Worker card fields: photo, name, work type, area, experience (years), availability, Call button (green), WhatsApp button
Worker registration fields: name, phone number, work category dropdown, area, experience, working time, upload photo; after submit show 'We will verify and publish your number' message
SEO targets: optimize for local intent searches (e.g., 'worker near me', 'maram vetra aal near me', 'electrician near me tamilnadu')
User preference: background should feel vibrant and more corporate in style (ensure readability on mobile).
Project renamed to “AREA WORKER” with tagline: “Find People Who Work Near You / உங்கள் அருகில் வேலை செய்யும் நபர்களை கண்டுபிடிக்கவும்”.
known_issues: App crash showing "Something went wrong" (observed after adding categories); likely caused by missing/invalid category/subcategory relations or unhandled API errors.
Broken/missing images/icons on the site; need local SVG icons for all categories/subcategories with a fallback icon when missing.

existing_features.title: Build a single-page premium modern corporate landing page for the textile production network brand named “ALLOVIKAAS”, optimized to recruit saree manufacturers, weavers, loom owners, and cloth producers into a manufacturing ecosystem network.

Add subtle textile-themed visuals: a low-opacity saree weave texture overlay and minimal fabric folds + loom silhouette accents that maintain a premium corporate feel and do not overpower content.
Implement the Hero section with the provided bilingual copy lines and a primary CTA button “Join Community / சமூகத்தில் இணையுங்கள்” that opens a registration modal popup.

Create a registration form popup (modal) with bilingual field labels and the exact fields: Name, Phone Number, City, Work Type (Manufacturer/Weaver/Seller/Home Producer), Monthly Production Capacity, Experience Years; include a submit button labeled “Continue to Activation / செயல்படுத்த தொடரவும்”.

Add an Activation/Payment section that communicates the one-time lifetime network activation fee (bilingual) and includes an “Activate Membership / உறுப்பினர் செயல்படுத்துக” button wired to a Razorpay link placeholder (configurable). After activation, reveal the WhatsApp community join link: https://chat.whatsapp.com/CFmJqmTQ9wUCdn09m0aopk

Create and use generated static image assets for the textile weave texture and subtle loom/fabric accents; store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

Update the landing page and registration modal copy to explicitly target saree resellers as eligible production partners, including changing any Work Type option text from “Seller” to “Reseller” where applicable, while preserving the message that ALLOVIKAAS is not a reseller selling website but a textile industry organization network.

Update the site’s global background styling to a more vibrant, corporate-style look while preserving mobile-first readability and the existing NAMMA OORU VELAI green/white/grey palette as the primary brand colors.

Rebrand the app UI copy and navigation to the new project name "AREA WORKER" and tagline "Find People Who Work Near You" while keeping the product positioned as community infrastructure (not an ecommerce marketplace).
